title: setResult+finish() 移植成一次 terminateSelfWithResult，带回结果码和 uri

triggers.read: 源码响应 MediaStore.ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE / ACTION_VIDEO_CAPTURE，结束时 setResult(RESULT_OK 或 RESULT_CANCELED, data) 再 finish()
triggers.wrong: 目标结果函数的成功和失败分支都只调 this.context.terminateSelf()，注释说调用方会读回 want，结果码和 uri 没进 AbilityResult

scope: 把 Activity 结果协议（被第三方用意图拉起、结束时回传结果）移植到鸿蒙 UIAbility 时

how.text: 写成一次 context.terminateSelfWithResult({ resultCode: ok ? -1 : 0, want: { uri } })：RESULT_OK 对 -1，RESULT_CANCELED 对 0
写完检查结果函数里的成功标志和 uri 是否真的写进了 AbilityResult，不能只调用 terminateSelf()

values.meaning: 销毁自身并把结果码和数据回传给调用方
只销毁自身，不回传任何结果
resultCode 放结果码，want 放回传数据（如 uri），可为空
源端结果码的取值，目标照搬

values.value: 修好后结果函数改为 async，先等保存队列，再 terminateSelfWithResult({ resultCode: -1 / 0, want.uri })

values.meaning: 同族接口：UIExtensionContentSession 上的同名方法

why: 只调 terminateSelf 时调用方收不到结果码和 uri，第三方拍照、录像永远拿不到成品

probe.note: 结束页面时没带结果；被意图拉起要回传结果的分支应改用 terminateSelfWithResult

unverified: 卡里的行为在 target SDK 6.1.1(24) 下观察，本机核实用的声明是 API 23
siblings_checked: 搜 terminateSelfWithResult(parameter: AbilityResult)：UIAbilityContext、UIExtensionContext、UIExtensionContentSession 和 FA 模型 featureAbility 各有一个；UIExtensionContentSession 写进了 values

refs.quote: Destroys the Page ability while returning the specified result code and data to the caller.
Destroys this Page ability. * * @returns { Promise<void> } The promise returned by the function.
Indicates the result code returned after the ability is destroyed. You can define the result * code to identify an error.
Indicates the data returned after the ability is destroyed. You can define the data returned. * This parameter can be null.
/** Standard activity result: operation canceled. */ public static final int RESULT_CANCELED = 0;
/** Standard activity result: operation succeeded. */ public static final int RESULT_OK = -1;
